name: Prepare Delivery
description: Pre-ship quality gates without the ship. Runs the full pre-merge pipeline — deslop (clean AI debris), simplify (de-bloat), agnix (lint agent configs), enhance (audit prompts/skills/hooks/plugins/docs), multi-agent review (audit-project), test-coverage check, delivery validation, sync-docs — and produces a unified pass/fail report. Doesn't push, doesn't create PRs, doesn't merge — just gates. Designed for the workflow where you want all the quality enforcement but the actual ship step happens later (or via a separate /ship invocation, or by hand).
longDescription:
Ships **4 skills**, **3 agents** and **1 command**.

- **Skills** (4): `check-test-coverage` (Use when validating test coverage quality for new code), `orchestrate-review` (Use when user asks to \"deep review the code\", \"thorough code review\", \"multi-pass review\", or when orchestrating the…), `prepare-delivery` (Use when user asks to \"prepare delivery\", \"run quality gates\", \"review code\", \"run pre-gates\", \"deslop and review\", \"validate…), `validate-delivery` (Use when user asks to \"validate delivery\", \"check readiness\", or \"verify completion\")
- **Agents** (3): `delivery-validator` (Validate task completion autonomously), `prepare-delivery-agent` (Run pre-ship quality gate pipeline), `test-coverage-checker` (Validate test coverage quality for new code)
- **Commands** (1): `prepare-delivery` (Run pre-ship quality gates - deslop, simplify, agnix, enhance, review loop, delivery validation, and docs sync)

Installs with `claude plugin install prepare-delivery@claude-community` from `agent-sh/prepare-delivery`.
